sentences.en: He chanced on a rare book at a second-hand bookstore.
sentences.zh: 他偶然在二手书店发现了一本稀有的书。

sentences.en: It was last week that John bought a second-hand car.
sentences.zh: 约翰上个星期买了一辆二手车。

sentences.en: The market on the promenade sells second-hand clothes and bric-a-brac.
sentences.zh: 海滨大道上的市场出售二手衣服和古董杂项。
